name: Hibiki Kanato
source:
1st year student.
Star Sign: Aquarius
Likes: Curry, Stew
Dislikes: Multi Course Meals

He looks scary but will always help someone in need. 
A friendly underclassman.
A sportsman who loves basketball. He's the eldest son of five siblings.
Majoring in cello, gentle tones are his specialty.
